screens.label: Initial Report Details Entry
screens.description: On this screen, you will enter the initial details of the child safety report. Please provide accurate information about the child, the method and timing of the report, and a narrative from the reporter. Use the provided fields to capture all required data. You may also use the 'Search Prior History' button to check for any previous agency involvement related to the child or household. Guidance and instructions are provided for each field to help you complete the intake accurately.

screens.label: Associated Individuals Entry
screens.description: On this screen, you will enter details for all individuals associated with the case, including household members, alleged victims, and alleged perpetrators. For each person, provide their name, role, relationship to the child, and any available contact information. You may add multiple individuals as needed. Use checkboxes to indicate victim or perpetrator status. Guidance is provided for each field, and you can mark relationships as unknown if necessary.

screens.label: Allegation Documentation

You may also document substance use and domestic violence if applicable. Use the autosuggest fields to select individuals from those previously entered. Additional instructions and guidance are provided for each field to ensure thorough documentation.

steps.label: Initial Report Details and Prior History Search
steps.description: On this screen, you will enter the initial details of the child safety report, including the child's information, report method, and narrative. You will also have the option to search for any prior history related to the child or household members. Guidance is provided for each field, and you can review previous agency involvement by clicking the 'Search Prior History' button. Please ensure all required fields are completed before proceeding.
data_validation: Date Logic: 'Date Report Received' cannot be in the future.
Format/Range Logic: 'Child Current Address' must be a valid address format.
Business Rules: 'Method of Report' must be selected.
Conditional Logic: If 'Additional Directions/Landmarks' provided, must be relevant to address.
Cross-field Logic: 'Time Report Received' must be within agency operating hours.

steps.description: This screen allows you to review all entered intake information before submission. Please verify that all required fields are complete and accurate. You may edit any section if needed. Once satisfied, click 'Submit Intake' to validate and store the record. You will receive confirmation and an audit trail entry will be created.

fields.label: Submit Intake
fields.error_message: Submission failed. Please check required fields.

data_validation: Business Rules: All mandatory fields across intake must be completed before submission.
Date Logic: All date fields must be valid and not in the future.
Format/Range Logic: All phone and email fields must be valid format.
Cross-field Logic: Logical consistency between related fields (e.g., age and birth date).
Conditional Logic: If any required field is missing, submission is blocked.

buttons.label: Submit Intake

steps.label: Allegation Documentation
steps.description: On this screen, you will document all specific allegations related to the case. Please select the type of allegation, identify the alleged victim and perpetrator, and provide all relevant details including incident date, time, and context. Additional information such as substance use and domestic violence can be recorded if applicable. Guidance is provided for each field to ensure thorough documentation.
data_validation: Relationship Logic: Alleged victim and perpetrator must be different individuals.
Date Logic: 'Date of Alleged Incident' cannot be in the future.
Business Rules: 'Allegation Type' and 'Source of Report' are required.
Cross-field Logic: If 'Domestic Violence Flag' is checked, 'Domestic Violence Details' and 'Domestic Violence Individuals Involved' must be provided.
Conditional Logic: If 'Date/Time Unknown' is checked, 'Date of Alleged Incident' and 'Time of Alleged Incident' can be left blank.
Format/Range Logic: 'Reporter Contact Info' must be valid format if provided.

ACTION_6.name: Mark Workflow Completion
ACTION_6.implementation: Marks the workflow as completed after intake review and validation.

steps.label: Assign to Supervisor
steps.description: System routes the intake record to the supervisor's queue for further review. The system enforces access permissions to ensure only authorized supervisors can view and act on the intake record. An audit trail entry is created to log the assignment event, capturing the date, time, user, and action performed.

assignments.label: Assign to Supervisor
assignments.logic: Upon completion of intake review and validation, the system automatically routes the intake record to the designated supervisor's queue. The routing logic checks supervisor availability and permissions. The system updates the audit trail with assignment details, including timestamp, assigned supervisor, and intake worker identity.

ACTION_7.name: Return to Initial Report Details
ACTION_7.implementation: Navigates back to the initial report details screen.

steps.label: Task: Supervisor Review Assignment
steps.description: Supervisor must review the intake record for further action. The system routes the intake record to the supervisor's queue, enforces access permissions, and updates the audit trail.

completionConditions.logic: Supervisor must access the assigned intake record, review all details for accuracy and completeness, and indicate review completion in the system. Audit trail entry must be created upon completion.

steps.label: Assign to Supervisor (Screen Out)
steps.description: System routes the screened-out intake record to the supervisor's queue for final review and closure. Access permissions are enforced to restrict visibility to authorized supervisors. An audit trail entry is created to log the assignment and closure event, including relevant metadata.

assignments.label: Assign to Supervisor (Screen Out)
assignments.logic: When the intake worker selects 'Screen Out' as the disposition decision, the system routes the intake record to the supervisor's queue for final review and closure. The system verifies supervisor permissions before assignment and updates the audit trail with the assignment and closure details, including timestamp, assigned supervisor, and intake worker identity.

steps.label: Task: Supervisor Final Review and Closure
steps.description: Supervisor must perform final review and closure of the intake record. The system routes the intake record to the supervisor's queue for final review and closure, enforces access permissions, and updates the audit trail.
steps.taskName: Supervisor Intake Final Review and Closure

completionConditions.logic: Supervisor must verify all intake information, ensure all required actions and documentation are complete, and formally close the intake record in the system. Audit trail entry must be created upon closure.
